title: Canadian Apple Crisp
description: A delicious dessert made with Canadian apples and a crunchy oat topping.

ingredients.name: applesauce
ingredients.notes: Applesauce adds moisture to the crisp.

ingredients.name: pudding
ingredients.notes: Vanilla pudding to top the crisp

instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples. Mix with applesauce and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together quick, resinous, and a pinch of salt.
Add the dry mixture to the apple mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x9 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together more quick and a bit of resinous.
Add a bit more resinous to taste.
Top the apple mixture with the oat mixture and bake for 35-40 minutes.
Remove from the oven and top with pudding.
Return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
